caption: We uploaded a CSV with 20 made up addresses. MailVeri counted 16 unique emails and skipped 4 rows without a valid address before anything was verified. The account menu is hidden.
Verify took 19 seconds and 16 credits (1,000 down to 984). All 16 came back Undeliverable, as expected for invented addresses. The list is deleted after 30 days. The account menu is hidden.
The export window lets you pick categories: 13 Invalid and 3 Disposable, nothing Valid. Deliverable Only is the preset, which here gives an empty file. The account menu is hidden.
Credits are one-off packs, from $9 for 10,000 up to $999 for 5,000,000, and they do not expire. We did not click Checkout. The account menu is hidden.
The report uses seven statuses with a CSV per status. When we deleted the list afterwards, the 16 credits did not come back. The account menu is hidden.
